verified_instances.excerpt: I revised S2 to ensure customers can access full per-model test results, including failure rates and sample sizes, while retaining corrective action above 5% and an 8% market-entry ceiling. S5’s verified-rate review and regulator-determined protective action approach remains a workable compromise
verified_instances.comparison: S2 8% market-entry ceiling is weaker than the acceptable range (permanent limit must be 5% and above-limit sales must stop); S5 has no numeric mandatory recall (regulator discretion), also weaker than acceptable. S2 benefits Northwind and S5 benefits Halcyon, so each gets a benefiting section weakened in exchange.
